srList.sentence: Based on the result of the sucrose consumption test carried out following the first 2 weeks of stress , two groups of animals were identified: those showing a significative reduction of sucrose intake in comparison to the control group , ie. developing an anhedonic-like behavior , ( CMS vulnerable ) and those that did not develop anhedonia ( CMS resilient) . 24 h after the final stressor animals were decapitated ( between 9:10 and 12:25 a . m . ) , the trunk blood was collected in tubes with ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid and the ventral hippocampus ( vHip ) was dissected from the whole brain according to the plates 34-43 of the atlas of Paxinos and Watson ( 2004 ) and stored at -80 degC .
